# Projection renderer

`plotly-basic-3.1.0.min.js` is the unmodified Plotly.js basic distribution from
https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-basic-3.1.0.min.js (MIT; license notice in its header).
The projection notebook embeds it in its iframe output, so no CDN access is
needed when viewing the lesson. Keep the version and filename pinned together.
